waiver_rules.medical_emergency: Airline waivers for passenger hospitalization require submitting Doctor Certificate + Hospital Admission Slip within 48 hours. Subject to airline approval. Akbar agency fee is waived.
waiver_rules.flight_cancellation_by_airline: Full 100% refund of airline fare and taxes if flight cancelled or delayed by > 3 hours by carrier. Zero Akbar fee deducted.
waiver_rules.b2b_agent_convenience: B2B Diamond/Platinum agents receive priority GDS ticket voiding within 30 minutes of issuance with zero airline penalty (GDS Void Window).
